rounds.text: Krystal Integrated Services Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a low P/E of 13.2 [E1] compared to its sector benchmark of 18.23x [E6], which leaves a massive 67.5% margin of safety based on a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 1913 per share against a market price of Rs 622 [E40] [E41]. This steep discount is unjustified given the company's exceptional track record, featuring a five-year compounded profit growth of 30% [E17] and trailing twelve-month profit growth of 21% [E19] that far outpaces the sector median profit growth of 15.3% [E65]. Furthermore, the business operates with high capital efficiency, boasting a 16.2% ROCE [E12] and a 13.8% ROE [E13] that vastly exceed their respective sector benchmarks [E9] [E10], all while maintaining a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.24x [E32]. Indeed, the current stock price implies a mere 2.5% earnings growth rate via a reverse DCF, which is highly conservative compared to the 18.0% base case assumption [E42]. Conceded: The company faces near-term headwinds, as working capital days have increased from 52.5 to 77.6 days [E56], resulting in a weak cash conversion ratio of 0.41x [E28]. However, the underlying strength of the business is reflected in its rules-based screen score of 82 out of 100 [E57] and positive technical momentum, with the price sitting above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E45].
